# OLITEC (Olitec Solar Private Limited)

> Hybrid inverters and lithium iron phosphate (LFP) energy storage systems in India, engineered as one unified platform and supported through our nationwide channel partner network.

## Company Overview
- Legal Entity: Olitec Solar Private Limited
- Manufacturing Facility: No. 127/2, Vallimalai Ring Road, Perumalkuppam, Katpadi Taluk, Vellore, Tamil Nadu 632 520, India
- Corporate Office: No. 5/63, Gateway House, House of Hiranandani, Egattur, OMR, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600 130, India
- Customer Care & Helpline: 8501 800 800 (Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM - 6:30 PM IST)
- Email: contact@olitec.in

## Core Products
- [OLI-1H Series Single-Phase Hybrid Inverter (3 to 6 kW)](/products/oli-1h-series-3-6kw): Compact residential & small-commercial hybrid inverter. Features up to 200% PV oversizing, 2 MPPTs, 40-60 V battery compatibility, <10 ms UPS backup switch-over, 97.3% peak efficiency, IP66 weatherproof enclosure, fanless <35 dB operation, and up to 6 units parallel scaling (36 kW). Models: OLI-1H3L, OLI-1H3.6L, OLI-1H4L, OLI-1H4.6L, OLI-1H5L, OLI-1H6L, OLI-1H5L-2.
- [OLI-3H Series Three-Phase Hybrid Inverter (15 to 30 kW)](/products/oli-3h-series-15-30kw): Commercial and industrial hybrid inverter. Supports up to 60 kW PV input, 2-3 MPPTs, 160-750 V HV battery range, 100% unbalanced three-phase output, AC coupling, diesel generator integration, <10 ms backup switch-over, 97.8% peak efficiency, IP66 enclosure, and up to 6 units parallel scaling (180 kW). Models: OLI-3H15H, OLI-3H20H, OLI-3H25H, OLI-3H29.9H, OLI-3H30H.
- [OLB-5.12 LFP Energy Storage Battery (5.12 kWh)](/products/olb-512-lfp-battery-wall): Cobalt-free LiFePO4 battery module at 51.2 V / 100 Ah. Certified to BIS, UN 38.3, IEC 62619, and UL 1973. Passive cooling, intelligent BMS, 4,000+ cycles at 80% DoD, RS485/CAN/RS232 communication, parallel scaling up to 10 packs (51.2 kWh). Models: OLB-5.12W (wall-mount), OLB-5.12R (3U 19-inch rack-mount).
